---
title: smalldocs 0.5.5
subtitle: A theme's licences go with its fonts
date: 2026-11-02
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A theme extension often brings its own fonts. The SIL Open Font License asks that each copy of such a
font carries its licence. Before, the build copied the fonts into the site, but not their licence files.

Now the build also copies the licence files of the theme into `site_libs/themes/<name>/`. It takes them
from the top of the extension folder, and from the folder of each copied file and each folder above it.
The logo and the favicon of the theme count as copied files. A licence file is a text file with a name
such as `LICENSE`, `BOOTSTRAP-LICENSE`, `NOTICE.md` or `inter-OFL.txt`.
[Themes](../guide/themes.qmd#what-the-build-copies) gives the exact rule.

A site with a Bootswatch theme or its own CSS file builds as before. A site with a theme extension gets
only the new licence files.
